title.en: RG 1 2014 ED WEIGHTS AND MEASURES VERIFICATION REGULATIONS

source.name: Attorney General's Chambers, Brunei Darussalam (AGC) — LAWS OF BRUNEI / Government Gazette

completenessNote: 来源为 AGC 官方 PDF《CAP-151-RG-1-2014-ED-WEIGHTS-AND-MEASURES-VERIFICATION-REGULATIONS.pdf》（6 页），本次切分 5 条。该 PDF 为扫描件 + OCR 文本层，正文按版式位置重建：已剔除页眉页脚与边栏条标题、回接折行；未改写措辞、未增删内容。OCR 层面可能存在个别粘连或形近字，逐字引用请以原始 PDF 为准。

text.en: These Regulations may be cited as the Weights and Measures (Verification) Regulations. Interpretation.

In these Regulations unless the context otherwise requires — “stamp of verification” means a stamp approved by the Minister for the purposes of verification under the Act. Stamping and verification of weights and measures.

(1) Every weight, measure and instrument for weighing used for trade shall be verified and stamped by an inspector with a stamp of verification under the Act.

(2) Every person who uses or has in his possession for use for trade any weight, measure and instrument for weighing not stamped as of required by this regulation is guilty of an offence and liable on conviction to a fine of $1,000, imprisonment for 3 months or both and the weight, measure or instrument for weighing shall be liable to be forfeited and any contract, bargain, sale or dealing made by such weight, measure or instrument for weighing shall be void. Lead or pewter weights.

(1) A weight made of lead, pewter or of any mixture thereof shall not be stamped with a stamp of verification or used for trade unless it is wholly and substantially cased with brass, copper or iron and legibly stamped or marked “cased”.

(2) Nothing in this section shall prevent the insertion into a weight of such a plug of lead or pewter as is in bona fide necessary for the purpose of adjusting it and of affixing thereon the stamp of verification. 4 CAP. 151, Rg 1 Weights and Measures Use of possession weights.

Any person who used or has in his possession for use for trade any weight, measure or instrument for weighing which is not in conformity with the standards established by the Act is guilty of an offence and liable an conviction to a fine $1,000, imprisonment for 3 months or both and the weight, measure or instrument for weighing shall be liable to be forfeited.
